title: Stage error catalog
description: Each stage defines its own errors + push-back destination. After adding, print the barcode to post at the station — scan the order then scan the error code to auto report + push back.
createSuccess: Error added — barcode ready to print.
hideSuccess: Error hidden (not deleted, to keep old stats).
okLabelSubtitle: Moves the order to the next stage
exportSuccess: Exported PDF: 1 OK label + {{count}} errors — one label per A8 page.
namePlaceholder: Error name — e.g. Color shift when pressing, Broken seam…
pushToLabel: Push back to stage (= error source):
empty: No errors yet. Add the first error in the form above.
printSheetDesc: Scan the ORDER barcode first → scan one code below. "{{ok}}" = complete the stage; error code = report an error + auto push back to the stage on the label.
